thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — ACME West air-gapped cluster bring-up tomorrow 08:00 PT. Dropping the minimal handoff checklist here so oncall + delivery have the same page.

kai: Thanks — can you call out the network bits we need from the customer?

maria: Yep. Customer must provide: static /30 for bastion, NAT rules for egress to our updater mirror, BGP routes to our transit (if using direct connect), MTU 9000 optional but preferred, IPSec pre-shared key for management VPN. Also need proxy CA bundle and apt/yum mirror endpoints.

devon: Adding infra checklist: ensure GPU quota reservation (A100-80GB x4), storage PV class test (iops target 5k), and node label scheme. I recommend reserving 2 spare GPUs for canary.

ben: Ops note on airgap tooling — run the offline registry seed before kubeadm join: 
```bash
./airgap/seed-registry.sh --customer acme-west --images images.tar.gz --mirror http://local-registry:5000
```
Confirm registry responds: `curl -k http://local-registry:5000/v2/_catalog`

sre-oncall: Smoke validation steps after join: 1) `kubectl get nodes -o wide` 2) `kubectl get pods -n redwood-system` 3) `curl --unix-socket /var/run/redwood.sock http://./healthz` 4) GPU check: `kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia-gpu -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.capacity}'` 5) run small GPT2 token test against local runtime.

maria: Add network ACLs: allow outbound to our mirror IPs (listed in delivery ticket), allow TLS to monitoring ingest on port 443 to our collector via proxy, NTP to customer's NTP pool, and SNMP only from our management bastion. No direct internet from worker nodes.

kai: Cost/regional constraints — note we have limited A100s in this DC; if kernel/driver mismatch forces us to use V100 fallback, call out expected perf delta (~2.5x slower p95) and bump reserved capacity. Also put a note for billing: reserve 24h minimum for delivery window to avoid hourly spikes.

ben: Small snippet for validating CUDA drivers inside a node: 
```bash
ssh core@bastion -- 'kubectl debug node/<node> -it --image=nvidia/cuda:11.7-base -- nvidia-smi'
```
Expect driver >= 525.60.13.

devon: Handoff to delivery: runbook link (internal) + manifest we used, and tag cluster with `customer/acme-west/airgap/2026-11-05`. Delivery should confirm VPN handshake + mirror access at least 2h before kubeadm start.

maria: I'll be oncall during bring-up, devon and ben will own registry and GPU validation. @sre-oncall please have rollback playbook ready (powercycle node, detach GPU pool, fallback model to hosted). ops-bot: create incident ticket for bring-up and attach this thread.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-ACME-WEST-2026-11-05. Assigned: maria, devon, ben, kai, sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: A few KPIs to capture post-provision: p95 token latency for 128 tokens, average GPU utilization for 1h, failed container pull rate (should be 0), and cost delta vs forecast (post 24h). We'll snapshot charts 30m after canary traffic.

maria: Perfect — thanks all. I'll post final go/no-go 06:45 PT tomorrow and attach the final manifest.
